t: A small round robot that runs MicroPython and follows lines out of the box.
steps: Buy an assembled 3pi+ 2040 Standard edition from Pololu or RobotShop.
Add four AAA rechargeable batteries and grab a USB-C cable.
Plug the robot into your computer and open the drive that appears.
Install Mu or Thonny as your code editor.
Copy a MicroPython example from the Pololu examples repo onto the drive.
Run the line following example on a loop of black tape.
Change one number, such as the speed, and save to see the effect.
meta: Open Board. From $74.95. A few stores.
